criteria.contract: Introduce an explicit new-game adult adoption policy and versioned case/relationship records. Separate proposer personal assent, the other adult personal answer, required house authority assent, implementation and existing succession/office/land systems. Preserve old saves without automatic migration.

A proposal records the exact parent/child roles, fixed local meeting site, known house representatives, original deadline and version. Both individuals must actually be adult and present for personal consultation; NPC answers are deterministic personal choices and never override player decisions.

Required house consents are distinct from personal consent and require actual local authority; player house consent is an explicit action. Missing/changed authority or absent people leave pending/unavailable rather than substituting a hidden new representative. Implementation rechecks all current consents and presence.

Withdrawal, deadline, refusals, duplicate actions and competing/cyclic adoption are validated without teleport, duplicate relation, automatic membership/office/land transfer or automatic heir entitlement. Completed relationship remains separately recorded; proposals are not already family.

Verify real proposal/answer/house approval/implementation and refusal paths, unchanged money and legal rights, actual generation recovery/equal future, old saved worlds and headless Godot positions; integrate tested code/docs automatically and continue.

limits: 最初の対象は成人同士の現地養子。婚姻・出生・史実血縁の採録・遠隔相談・幼年予約・家督候補資格の自動設定は未実装。相談開始は開始時所属と現在所属が一致する人物に限定し、所属変更後の家の再確認は後続。性格によるNPC返答は試作係数。親族関係を勝手な継承権や領土統合へ変換しない。
